code.description: UNAUTHORIZED = wrong or missing helper secret (HTTP 401). AUTH_REQUIRED = no Autodesk sign-in (401). FORBIDDEN 403. NOT_FOUND 404. INVALID_REQUEST 400. NOT_CONFIGURED 409 (no client ID). UNSUPPORTED_GEOMETRY 422. DATA_ONLY_EXCHANGE 422 (AEC Data Model based exchange: data only, no geometry). NETWORK_ERROR and SDK_UNAVAILABLE 503. INTERNAL_ERROR 500.

message.description: Safe to show to the user. Never holds tokens or model data.

correlationId.description: Matches a line in the helper log.
